title: Rav Idit
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 38b: a great man in the time of Rav Nachman, who used to argue with the heretics (minim). And Rav Nachman said of him: "Whoever knows how to answer the heretics like Rav Idit, let him answer; and if not, let him not answer." And the reading in Dikdukei Soferim and in Yalkut, Mishpatim, remez 359, is "Rav Idi."

notes.text: Dikdukei Soferim and Yalkut Mishpatim 359 are cited by Hyman for the form Idi rather than Idit.
